title: Workbook series bindings
description: Declarative structure and spreadsheet bindings for generated input setters/readers, constant readers, and output compute functions. Shared series structure describes dimensions and data_range; optional input, output, internal, and constant blocks declare generated APIs or triangulation targets.

schema_version.description: Schema version for tooling and migrations. 1.0.0–1.2.0: row_series and scalar (fully supported). 1.1.0: adds matrix layout (supported with explicit binds). 1.2.0: optional input/output direction blocks and output compute functions. 1.3.0: row_series renamed to series layout; load-time normalization accepts legacy row_series. 1.4.0: adds bool and datetime read modes and dtypes for dimensions and constants (ISO 8601 date strings in manifests). 1.5.0: grouped-row matrix geometry (skip/include/fill/missing on row_label and column_header binds, value_map bind kind, series-level exclude_rows) and optional view-level groups for export sequencing and documentation grouping. 1.6.0: input.mode override for user-editable formula cells (non-leaf input setters). 1.7.0: internal direction for non-I/O formula-cell key triangulation (intersect_graph_formulas validation). 1.8.0: optional dimension/attribute id separating dimension identity from concept, so multiple dimensions can share one concept; record fields and key entries use the effective id (id when declared, else concept) while concept keeps dtype inheritance from concept_scheme. Also adds optional per-dimension dtype overriding the concept-scheme dtype for same-concept dimensions with differing storage types. 1.9.0: optional input.reader name override for generated read_* duals of set_* setters (codegen always emits readers for input series; omit input.reader to default to read_<series_id>). 1.10.0: optional output.compute.helper so compute_* evaluates collapsed / parameterized helpers from record dims instead of xl_cell(address) when a helper covers the published leaves. 1.11.0: constant direction for non-I/O graph-leaf bindings that emit read_* (and Phase 2 body rewrite) without set_* or compute_*. 1.12.0: series-level exclude_columns (ColumnSpec) symmetric with exclude_rows for carving non-data columns out of an expanded data_range. 1.13.0: optional input.domain so generated set_* setters reject out-of-domain measure values (enum literals, integer between, real_between). 1.14.0: complementary shards with the same series id may declare different sheet/data_range (merged data_range is a list); bind.kind sheet_name reads the worksheet name of each data cell, with an optional values map from worksheet name to dimension code. 1.15.0: optional input.value_map on scalar input series maps public compute_*/setter values to workbook cell needles (MATCH/IF labels); domain checks use the map keys.

workbook.description: Optional workbook filename or path used when validating bindings against a graph extract.

concept_scheme.description: Optional shared concept definitions referenced by series bindings in this file.

series.description: One binding per generated setter (MVP: one logical indicator series each). Empty lists are allowed for draft/placeholder shards.

A1Range.description: Sheet-qualified range using project target conventions: Inputs!F5:J5, Inputs!F5:Inputs!J5, 'My Sheet'!A1:'My Sheet'!B2. Parsed via expand_targets_to_roots (not a single regex).

DefinedName.description: Workbook defined name resolving to a single cell or rectangular range (requires workbook or graph named-range maps at expand time).

DataRange.description: Leaf cells for this binding: sheet-qualified range and/or defined name.

DataRangeList.description: One or more DataRange entries concatenated at resolve time (complementary shards).

SheetName.description: Worksheet name (must match a data_range sheet).

SheetNameList.description: Worksheet names covered by a multi-range complementary series.

ColumnLetter.description: Excel column letters without row, e.g. A or AA.

ConceptId.description: Stable concept identifier (SDMX-style ids such as REF_AREA or local ids such as DESCRIPTION).

DimensionId.description: Dimension (or attribute) identifier distinguishing the dimension from the concept it references (SDMX concept identity). Defaults to the concept id when omitted; effective ids must be unique within a series' structure. Record fields and key entries use the effective id; concept_scheme dtype inheritance keys on concept.

ScalarValue.description: Constant attribute or context value stored in records when include_in_record is true. Datetime constants use ISO 8601 strings (e.g. 2024-01-15 or 2024-01-15T00:00:00); tooling coerces them when read or dtype is datetime.

RowSpec.description: One 1-based row index, or an inclusive row range string like 3:8.

ColumnSpec.description: One column letter, or an inclusive column range string like C:D.

MissingPolicy.description: What to do when no source label exists for a data cell: error (default) fails resolution; null keys the cell on None. YAML null is accepted as a spelling of "null".

ReadAs.description: How to coerce a cell or header value into a record field.

Normalize.description: Label normalization applied after reading strings from the sheet.

sdmx_concept.description: Optional mapping to an external SDMX concept id for documentation.

Bind.description: How to obtain a concept value from the workbook for each leaf cell in data_range.

header_row.description: 1-based row index containing column headers for the data columns.

skip.description: Columns in header_row that are not label sources for this dimension. Mutually exclusive with include.

include.description: The only columns in header_row that are label sources for this dimension. Mutually exclusive with skip.

fill.description: When true, a data column whose header source is skipped or empty inherits the nearest non-skipped, non-empty header to its left.

BindRowLabel.description: Read the label on the same row as the data cell from label_column (typical for indicator text in column A).

skip.description: Rows in label_column that are not label sources for this dimension (e.g. group header rows for a sub-label key). Mutually exclusive with include.

include.description: The only rows in label_column that are label sources for this dimension (e.g. group header rows for a band key). Mutually exclusive with skip.

fill.description: When true, a data row whose label source is skipped or empty inherits the nearest non-skipped, non-empty label above it.

BindValueMap.description: Key data rows or columns by manifest values when labels are absent from the sheet. Axis is inferred from spec syntax: row specs (3, 3:4) key data rows; column specs (C, C:D) key data columns. Map keys within one bind must share one scalar type.

values.description: Mapping from dimension value to the row or column specs it covers.
Map from worksheet name to dimension code. When omitted, the worksheet name of each data cell is the dimension value.

GroupRef.description: View-level group membership for export sequencing and documentation. Affects only the generated API shape, never graph extraction or record semantics.

path.description: Nested group labels, outermost to innermost (e.g. ['Climate scenarios', 'Paris']).

order.description: Optional intra-group sequencing hint. Members without order fall back to binding declaration order.

DimensionScope.description: series: one value for the entire binding (e.g. country in A2). cell: varies per leaf (e.g. TIME_PERIOD from column header).

DimensionRole.description: key: participates in record matching. attribute: metadata only unless listed in key.

dtype.description: Per-dimension storage type overriding the concept-scheme dtype for this dimension only. Use when same-concept dimensions store different types (e.g. an int projection axis and a datetime reference period sharing TIME_PERIOD); an explicit bind read still wins for coercion.

include_in_record.description: When false and scope is series, value is used for validation only and omitted from emitted Records unless listed in series_context.

value.description: Shorthand for bind.kind constant when the attribute is fixed for the series.

concept.description: Observation value concept (required field name value in Records).

name.description: Parameterized helper callable `(ctx, **dims) -> CellValue` covering the published output leaves (typically a post-refactor internals helper).

dims.description: Binding concept / effective ids passed as kwargs from the static record. Defaults to the series key when omitted.

name.description: Generated Python function name, e.g. compute_borvelia_primary_balance.

record_contract.description: list[Record] with OBS_VALUE and all declared dimensions.

include_address.description: When true, each output record includes address or cell_address.

helper.description: Optional parameterized helper covering this series' published leaves. When set, compute_* calls the helper from static record dims instead of xl_cell(address). Leaves without helper coverage (via address overlay) still use xl_cell.

name.description: Generated Python function name, e.g. read_borvelia_primary_balance. Defaults to read_<series_id> when omitted.

InputDomainBounds.description: Closed numeric interval; at least one of min or max is required.

InputDomainIntBounds.description: Closed integer interval; at least one of min or max is required.

InputDomain.description: Allowed measure values for generated set_* setters. Checked after dtype coercion; exact match for enum (trailing spaces preserved).

enum.description: Closed set of allowed measure values (exact match).

mode.description: Input binding semantics. leaf (default): data_range cells must be graph leaves. override: allow formula cells with dependents; setters write effective values that suppress formula evaluation until changed.

reader.description: Optional override for the generated read_* dual of the setter. When omitted, codegen emits read_<series_id>.

domain.description: Optional measure-value domain enforced by the generated setter at call time. When `value_map` is set and `domain` is omitted, the domain is the map keys.

value_map.description: Optional map from public scalar input values to workbook cell values (MATCH/IF needles). Applied after `input.domain` at the inverted-tree orchestrator and in `set_*` coercion, before the value enters any expression. Distinct from bind.kind `value_map`.

InputValueMap.description: Public scalar value to workbook needle. Keys are the caller-facing domain; values are the literal cell text the formula compares against.

InternalDirection.description: Marks a non-I/O binding for formula-cell key triangulation. No set_*, read_*, or compute_* codegen is emitted.

ConstantDirection.description: Marks a non-I/O graph-leaf binding for semantic read_* codegen and Phase 2 body rewrite. No set_* or compute_* APIs are emitted.

reader.description: Optional override for the generated read_* name. When omitted, codegen emits read_<series_id>.

name.description: Generated Python function name, e.g. set_borvelia_primary_balance.

record_contract.description: list[Record] with required OBS_VALUE and key fields.

allow_address.description: When true, records may include address/cell_address for disambiguation.

strict.description: When true, reject records with unknown keys and missing required key fields.

Layout.description: Optional declarative intent for analysts and layout-specific validation. Resolution and codegen use bind kinds, not layout name. series: one-dimensional data_range with at least one cell-scoped dimension when declared. scalar: single leaf. matrix: rectangular multi-row data_range with at least two dimensions and a cell-scoped dimension when declared.

sheet.description: Worksheet name (must match data_range sheet). A list when complementary shards cover multiple sheets.

data_range.description: Numeric input cells for this setter; codegen intersects with graph leaves. A list concatenates complementary shard ranges at resolve time.

layout.description: Optional analyst-facing layout intent; triggers layout-specific schema and validation rules when set.

exclude_rows.description: Rows within data_range that are never data (e.g. group header or separator rows referenced by lookup formulas). Applied before graph-leaf intersection.

exclude_columns.description: Columns within data_range that are never data for this series (e.g. milestone years published on a separate summary series). Applied after data_range expansion alongside exclude_rows, before graph-leaf intersection. Distinct from column_header skip/include, which only filter label sources.

setter.description: Deprecated: use input.setter. Accepted for backward compatibility and normalized at load time.

groups.description: Optional view-level groups sequencing the generated set_*/compute_* API. Omitted or empty reproduces the flat export.

key.description: Effective dimension ids (dimension id when declared, else concept) required on each incoming record for matching (MVP series: typically [TIME_PERIOD] when country and indicator are series-scoped). Scalar layout may use an empty key when the binding resolves to a single cell.

series_context.description: Fixed key-values attached to every record and setter docs; not used for matching unless also listed in key.

sdmx_notes.description: Human-readable SDMX fit commentary; not consumed by codegen.

SeriesBindingInputValueMapRules.description: input.value_map is allowed only on layout scalar input series (1.15.0).

SeriesBindingLayoutKeyRules.description: Non-scalar layouts require at least one key and dimension; scalar may use empty key and dimensions.

SeriesBindingDirectionRules.description: Each series must declare at least one of input, output, internal, constant, or legacy setter.

SeriesBindingInternalExclusivity.description: internal direction is mutually exclusive with input, output, constant, and legacy setter.

SeriesBindingConstantExclusivity.description: constant direction is mutually exclusive with input, output, internal, and legacy setter.

intersect_graph_leaves.description: When true, every cell in data_range must be a leaf in the extracted dependency graph (input leaf mode and constant bindings).

require_unique_key.description: When true, resolved key tuples must be unique across leaves in data_range.

warn_on_partial_overlap.description: When true, emit a warning when data_range cells are skipped because they are absent from the graph.

intersect_graph_nodes.description: When true for output bindings, only cells present in the extracted graph are included.

intersect_graph_formulas.description: When true for internal bindings, only formula cells present in the extracted graph are included.

series.sdmx_notes: Wide row: TIME_PERIOD from row 1 offsets 1-5; REF_AREA from A2; indicator from A5.

series.notes: Illustrative 1.1.0 matrix binding with explicit row_label and column_header binds.
